text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: automated alert from EvalWatcher: safety/regression score spike on production prompt set 'billing-help' — threshold exceeded (0.72 -> 0.89). Pager issued to oncall. Severity: P2.

PagerDuty: Pager dispatched to Alex (oncall) — please acknowledge. Escalation policy: 10m -> Maria SRE.

Alex (oncall): acked. I’m on it. Can someone drop the recent model/variant IDs?

Jamie (ML Eng): I see a cluster of failing eval examples in the last 12m, all triggered by the new quantized v2 model we rolled at 10:03 UTC (model: rwd-medu-q8-v2). Spike correlates with rolling deploy at 10:03.

Maria SRE: Alex, are we seeing increased error rates or customer 5xxs? Logs show no 5xx spike, but latency on long-context paths increased ~30ms.

Ola (CS): Running into a live customer chat where the assistant returned a disallowed content snippet twice. It looks like the safety classifier downstream suppressed one but not the other. Customer impacted: ACME Corp support bot. They escalated.

Alex (oncall): Good to know. Priority on safety. Jamie — can we toggle routing to the previous safe variant while we investigate?

Jamie (ML Eng): Yes. Initiating traffic swap to rwd-stable-2025 (pre-quantized) for the billing-help route only. Applying policy: route(policy: "eval_fallback", scope: "/api/v1/generate?route=billing-help"). Command: ```rwctl route swap --route billing-help --from rwd-medu-q8-v2 --to rwd-stable-2025 --dry-run=false```

SRE Tools Bot: Executed: rwctl route swap — change propagated to 6 pods, new routing weight 100% to rwd-stable-2025 for billing-help.

Maria SRE: Confirmed traffic shift. Monitoring for regressions and to see if EvalWatcher alert clears.

Incident Bot: EvalWatcher: rolling checks started. Current safety/regression score on billing-help: 0.54 (dropping).

Ola (CS): I notified ACME that we’re investigating and routing to a safer model; asked for any transcripts. They sent two examples via secure upload. I pasted them in #sensitive (link redacted).

Jamie (ML Eng): Thanks — I’ll reproduce locally. Preliminary: the failure mode looks like an overly aggressive token merging in quantized kernels causing hallucinated policy text. Not a prompt template change.

Tina (Product): Do we need to embargo the new quantized variant? Also want to confirm whether any other customer routes hit this model.

Jamie (ML Eng): We only routed billing-help and one internal canary to v2. Canary was tiny. I recommend pausing further rollouts and marking the build as 'investigate/blocked'.

Alex (oncall): Agreed. Maria, can you open a short-lived incident bridge for cross-team triage? Use zoom id 444-555-666.

Maria SRE: Bridge up: zoom.us/j/444555666 — joining.

SRE Tools Bot: Pager duty escalation timer paused (acknowledged). Next escalation suspended while incident is active.

Jamie (ML Eng): Local repro command: ```python reproduce_regression.py --model rwd-medu-q8-v2 --prompt-file acme_examples.json --max-tokens 256```. Reproduced unsafe snippet. Will bisect quantization commit.

Alex (oncall): While Jamie bisects, can we apply a temporary eval gate override so the system doesn't auto-retry generated outputs back into user-facing streams? I want aggressive suppression of generation-to-storage and to block any fine-tune feedback for these prompts.

Maria SRE: Set gate: ```rwctl evalgate set --route billing-help --mode locked --reason "safety regression 1768888888"``` — locked. Also disabled feedback ingestion for that route.

Incident Bot: EvalGate: route billing-help locked by Maria SRE. Users on that route will be served fallback policy until unlocked.

Ola (CS): ACME confirmed that their bot is back to safe responses after routing switch. They requested ETA and whether we’ll share root cause. I told them we’ll follow up after the postmortem.

Jamie (ML Eng): Found the commit that likely introduced problem: quant-kernel change abc123 -> candidate. Rolling that commit out locally reproduces the regression. I can prepare a revert patch.

Alex (oncall): Do it. Also add a monitoring check for any other routes using quant-kernel abc123.

Jamie (ML Eng): Revert prepared: ```git revert abc123 --no-edit && make build && deploy --tag rwd-medu-q8-v2-revert```. Starting build.

SRE Tools Bot: Build queued, estimated 3m. Canary will run on internal only.

Maria SRE: While build runs, status check: customer-impacting count = 1 (ACME), error reports = 0, safety alerts = decreasing. Recommend we hold open incident until revert deploys and monitoring is green for 30m.

Tina (Product): Please include timeline text for ACME (what we did, why, next steps). I’ll draft customer-friendly language.

Ola (CS): Got it — drafting now. Will ping legal if we need to include any regulatory disclosures.

SRE Tools Bot: Deploy complete: rwd-medu-q8-v2-revert rolled to internal canary (5 pods). Running integration smoke tests.

Jamie (ML Eng): Canary looks clean. No unsafe outputs on test set. Advancing to billing-help route now. Command: ```rwctl route swap --route billing-help --from rwd-stable-2025 --to rwd-medu-q8-v2-revert --dry-run=false```.

SRE Tools Bot: Route swap executed; billing-help now on rwd-medu-q8-v2-revert.

Incident Bot: EvalWatcher: safety/regression score now 0.47 on billing-help. Alert cleared.

Alex (oncall): Nice work. Maria, can we start the post-incident checklist? I want notes on timeline, customer impact, rollbacks, and follow-ups: - formal rollback policy for quant kernels - canary size policy - add additional eval tests for billing-help prompt set - update deploy checklist to include safety Validators in quant builds.

Maria SRE: Creating incident ticket: INC-2026-1768888888. Assigning to Jamie (owner), Maria (SRE lead), Ola (customer comms). Will schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 15:00 UTC.

Ola (CS): Sent ACME update: short summary + that we've reverted to the stable variant and will share postmortem. They replied: thanks for the quick handling, no customer data leaked.

Jamie (ML Eng): Action items I’m taking: 1) add targeted evals for billing-help into preflight; 2) revert is in CI smoke, will add test for quant merge behaviour; 3) prepare root-cause section for postmortem.

Alex (oncall): Any final actions before we close? If monitoring stays stable for 30m, I’ll close this thread.

Incident Bot: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged and marked 'under investigation'. Escalation timers resumed for follow-ups.

Tina (Product): I’ll review follow-ups to prioritize product-level mitigations (e.g., route-level safety budgets).

Maria SRE: Acknowledged. Closing bridge in 30m if green. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Alex (oncall): closing ack. Good job team.

Ola (CS): logging notes for ACME.

SRE Tools Bot: Incident ticket INC-2026-1768888888 created. Postmortem template attached.
